fox.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Approved grey fox sheet is reference/edit target, preserve the SAME animal's huge ears, dull eyes, grey fur and muted cream chest, chibi proportions and pixel art clusters. Create new animation sheet STRICT FOUR columns SIX rows equal square cells. First THREE rows STALK front/back(no face)/right profile, four successive slow cautious walking steps: thin frightened fox head LOW, tail lowered near ground, paws carefully placed, hunched, NOT monster, no glow or snarl. Last THREE rows SHAKE front/back/right profile, four cells containing two alternating poses repeated: fox stands hunched and trembles, ears/fur move very slightly, feet fixed. Transparent background, ample padding, NO ground, shadow, text, grid or scenery. Whole animal in each cell, equal ground baseline and same head/body dimensions as approved reference. Keep grey colours and dull eyes. Front looks toward viewer; back has no face; side faces right.
